Tiny Fixture Document One

Abstract

   A small document used by the test suite. It is written in the layout
   of an RFC so that the section parser sees real headings.

1.  Introduction

   Gardens need water. A garden that receives no water will wilt within
   a few days in summer.

1.1.  Watering Schedule

   Water tomatoes every morning. Water cactus plants once a month.

   Never water during the hottest hour of the day.

2.  Soil

   Compost improves soil structure and feeds earthworms.
